argv:
import json, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, "scripts")
import planning_stats as P
t = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
row = json.loads(Path("tests/fixtures/ledger/good-completed.json").read_text())
row["subagents"] = {"calls": {"value": 2, "source": "observed"}, "tokens": {"value": 1234, "source": "observed"}}
(t / "row.json").write_text(json.dumps(row))
out = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "scripts/ledger.py", "routing-row", str(t / "row.json"), "metrics", "M"], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert out.returncode == 0, out.stderr
assert out.stdout.count("\n") == 1, out.stdout
got = json.loads(out.stdout)
want = {"run_id": "5f0c1e2a-7b3d-4c8e-9a1f-2d6b8e4c7a10", "task": "T-027", "category": "metrics", "size": "M",
        "seat": "claude.economy", "door": "claude", "model": "claude-haiku-5-5", "effort": "medium", "attempt": 1,
        "outcome": "completed", "failure_class": None, "duration_s": 413, "input_tokens": 58210, "output_tokens": 9342,
        "cache_read_tokens": 401775, "subagents": {"calls": 2, "tokens": 1234, "source": "observed"}, "source": "computed"}
assert got == want and list(got) == list(want), got
assert out.stdout == json.dumps(want, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n"
row.pop("subagents"); row["tokens_cache"] = {"value": None, "source": "unknown"}
(t / "row2.json").write_text(json.dumps(row))
out2 = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "scripts/ledger.py", "routing-row", str(t / "row2.json"), "metrics", "M"], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert out2.returncode == 0, out2.stderr
got2 = json.loads(out2.stdout)
assert got2["cache_read_tokens"] is None and got2["subagents"] == {"calls": None, "tokens": None, "source": "unknown"}, got2
row["tokens_input"] = 5
(t / "bad.json").write_text(json.dumps(row))
bad = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "scripts/ledger.py", "routing-row", str(t / "bad.json"), "metrics", "M"], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert bad.returncode != 0 and bad.stdout == "", (bad.returncode, bad.stdout)
rows = [{"type": "architect-run", "plan": f"p{i}", "seat": "s", "model": "m", "input_tokens": 100 * (i + 1), "output_tokens": 0, "cache_read_tokens": 0, "subagent_stats": {"spawned": 2}, "outcome": "done"} for i in range(10)]
rows.append({"type": "architect-run", "plan": "x", "seat": "s", "model": "m", "input_tokens": 999999, "output_tokens": 0, "cache_read_tokens": 0, "subagent_stats": {"spawned": 2}, "outcome": "done", "source": "manual"})
data = t / "d.jsonl"
data.write_text("".join(json.dumps(r) + "\n" for r in rows))
assert P.summarize(data)["all"] == {"runs": 10, "median_total": 550}, P.summarize(data)
(t / "b.json").write_text(json.dumps({"name": "b", "run_ids": [f"plan:p{i}" for i in range(10)]}))
s = P.batch_summary(t / "b.json", data)
assert (s["median_parent_total"], s["median_parent_plus_subagent_total"], s["median_subagent_calls"], s["done"]) == (550, None, None, 10), s
(t / "x.json").write_text(json.dumps({"name": "x", "run_ids": [f"plan:p{i}" for i in range(9)] + ["plan:x"]}))
try:
    P.batch_summary(t / "x.json", data)
except P.PlanningStatsError as exc:
    assert "plan:x" in str(exc) and "not found" in str(exc), str(exc)
else:
    raise SystemExit("a manual row was used")
print("ok")
